description:
One day, the protagonist wakes up in the body of Charlotte, a gentle healer living in a world of magic and nobility. Her new life seems peaceful, until she discovers that Charlotte had just accepted a suspicious commission: to create a love potion. The problem? Charlotte isn’t a witch, just a misunderstood herbalist mistaken for one. And before she can figure out who requested the potion, the Crown Prince himself shows up at her door. Convinced he’s the mysterious client, Charlotte panics. If she refuses now, she might lose her head for disobedience! So she decides to fake it till she makes it, brewing potions by instinct and stumbling into one awkward royal encounter after another. But the more she tries to survive, the more tangled her fate becomes with his.

*“Wait… isn’t this one of those classic romance clichés?”*

Apparently, it’s now her life.

(Source: Lezhin US)
